summary: the cases of tests/run diskrate under etude, against an exFAT driver that walks a cluster chain from its start for every call, an AHCI driver that finishes a write without its flush, and a pipe that copies one byte fewer than a large read reports

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 rach2-recovery && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel && mkdir -p ${WORK}/recovery && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK}/recovery rach2-recovery/kernel

faults.name: chain-from-start
faults.summary: exFAT ignores a node's chain hint and walks every cluster chain from its first cluster

faults.name: no-flush
faults.summary: AHCI finishes every write at its transfer, with no flush after it

faults.name: short-copy
faults.summary: a pipe read of more than 60000 bytes copies one byte fewer of each piece than it reports

lines: assert runs fail a read reported bytes it did not copy
